errors.error_description: The combinational always block for the mux explicitly omits d2_m and d3_m from the sensitivity list while reading them inside, creating a sensitivity list mismatch.
The state enum includes ST_ERR, which is never reachable by any transition, introducing an unreachable state in the FSM.
The mux case statement does not cover all possible values of sel_eff and lacks a default assignment to y_core, causing an unintended latch inference.
The internal net y_bus is driven by two continuous assignments, creating multiple drivers that can contend.
